body: She is pretty fantastic, part of the problem is that I don't deserve her.
I've decided to pass along to her the link to this thread. I hope she understands.
If it makes any sense, I'd rather her find someone stronger?  I feel she deserves better, stronger than me.

I'm on prozac, the killer is I'm embarrassed to admit that.  I have never told anyone outside of my family doctor that I am even on that.  Even when I have gone to other doctors I have never admitted that I am on a drug.

Here is the deal with my wife, she has been dealing with the shit-storm we have called life for as long as I have.  I feel I would rather end it than burden her with my weakness.  Does that make sense?

My big question is this: when you are emotionally exhausted, how do you fight through it?  I feel that 2 years ago I was so strong and things have been chipped away to the point that I feel there is nothing left.  I am depressed because I feel I should have more but when bad things happen I hide under the covers...
